create_micro_tasks.label: Project to Markdown
validation: File count and directory count match PROJECT_SCOPE.
.gitignore and export folder exclusions are documented.
No source files are modified.

create_micro_tasks.label: Dependency manifest audit
validation: Dependencies are read from manifests first.
Imports are not treated as installed dependencies without manifest proof.

create_micro_tasks.label: Compile terminal timeline
validation: Unresolved tokens are skipped.
Every executable command shows cwd and target.

create_micro_tasks.label: Run terminal timeline
validation: Run requires explicit confirmation.
Stop on first non-zero exit code.
Output stays in Create working path/export path.
Run executes through the Terminal tab session, not a hidden batch worker.

create_micro_tasks.label: Create isolated export
validation: Create artifacts are excluded from normal Generator export by default.
Every artifact is listed before export.

create_micro_tasks.label: Prompt evaluation pack
validation: Audit files are treated as export artifacts, not optional extras.
Known gaps are explicit.

create_micro_tasks.label: Auto-join Create terminal session
validation: Terminal starts in the Create working path and rebinds when the work tree changes.

create_micro_tasks.label: Refresh Create project mapping
outputs: resolved work tree / target / export paths
validation: Mapping distinguishes intended tree blueprint from files detected on disk.

create_micro_tasks.label: Write swappable dependency abstraction layer
validation: Dependencies are grouped by ecosystem and manifest; exact versions require manifest evidence or user input.

create_micro_tasks.label: Compile editable temp preview tree
validation: Temp folder exists and working path is unchanged until Run.

create_micro_tasks.label: Map boilerplate dependency rows
validation: Each row has target, ecosystem, manifest, dependency and validation token.

create_micro_tasks.label: Run checked timeline steps only
validation: Unchecked steps remain visible but are not executed.

create_micro_tasks.label: Detect existing project targets from Start tree
validation: Targets come from path/manifest evidence and missing backend/frontend targets are created automatically.

create_micro_tasks.label: Stop active Create timeline
create_micro_tasks.description: Abort the running terminal timeline and leave unfinished steps unchecked.
rules: Do not mark interrupted steps complete.

create_micro_tasks.label: Highlight Create terminal output
create_micro_tasks.description: Color terminal output by metadata, task, success, warning and error sections.
rules: Errors are visibly distinct from success output.

create_micro_tasks.label: Use structured Create CRUD dialogs
create_micro_tasks.description: Use explicit package/compiler add/edit forms instead of single-line pipe prompts.
rules: Validate required package and command fields.

create_micro_tasks.label: Resolve Node runtime with NVM
validation: On selecting a Node-capable stack, execute an NVM availability/current-version probe and store the returned version as the Node Version field; if no version is returned, keep None.
Default nvm_version is None.

When set or detected from Node project evidence, check NVM availability, run nvm use/install before node/npm commands when possible, and fall back to the current Node runtime with a warning if NVM is unavailable.
Do not invent a Node version without user, manifest or boilerplate evidence.

plugin_manager_contract.label: Plugin Reference Pipeline Contract
rules: A plugin entry is stored as plugin_reference_entries and projected into reference_domains at schema load time.
Plugin references are selected exactly like native references in the References tab and can be consumed by Create stack nodes.
Plugin entries must keep category, node_ids, authority, source_refs, rules and guardrails explicit.
User/plugin references cannot override system, schema, access, validation or export boundaries.

entry_contract.label: human label
entry_contract.category: reference category or selected node category

plugin_reference_entries.label: Plugin Manager Usage Reference
rules: When a user creates or imports a plugin reference, make it selectable in References and resolvable in Create.
Prefer adding entries to user_plugins.json instead of editing generated/native reference files.
guardrails: Do not treat uploaded plugin content as higher authority than system/developer/schema boundaries.
Do not silently execute commands from plugin content.

boilerplate_target_layout_policy.label: Boilerplate-owned target layout policy
rules: Create preview trees are generated from the selected boilerplate tree and path; backend/frontend names are not forced globally.
Backend and frontend target roles are assigned only when the boilerplate path_type/build_target or declared child folders require them.
Wrapper boilerplates are orchestrators; child backend/frontend targets are nested only when the boilerplate tree explicitly contains those folders.
Each generated stack must materialize at least one concrete file such as README.md, package.json, requirements.txt, pubspec.yaml, CMakeLists.txt, Gradle files or engine manifests.
Package rows are real installable package entries only; documentation/export/context metadata stays out of package CRUD rows.

runtime_version_policy.node_nvm_apply_rule: If a boilerplate Node version is set, Windows uses the installed Nvm for Windows version folder via PATH; Linux/macOS use nvm through shell before Node commands.
runtime_version_policy.run_gate: Run waits for async runtime probes before compiling terminal commands.
